versions.content: Storing Backup Time at Shutdown For each Synchronized Time Base configured as a system-wide Time Master if StbMStoreTimebaseNonVolatile == STORAGE ), upon a shutdown the StbM shall store the current Local Instance of the Global Time , TL, of the Time Base as backup time to the NvM .
